title: Compete matrix
description: Generic structure for a competitive capability matrix attached to a Databricks feature. One instance feeds the Landscape tab of a feature's panel. Scoring is fair: it records where the field wins as well as where Databricks wins.

feature.description: Tree node this matrix belongs to, by its display name (e.g. "AI Gateway").

featurePath.description: Optional path array (pillar → capsule → …) to bind the matrix to an exact node, same convention as the note-fill merge.

home.description: The id (from competitors[]) of the Databricks offering = the highlighted home column.

updated.description: Month/date the data was last verified, e.g. "2026-10".

legend.description: Status enum used by every cell. Keys are the status ids; values are how to render them.

symbol.description: Glyph shown in the cell, e.g. "✓".

segments.description: How the field is classified relative to the home offering (true fight, platform, complementary, DIY/OSS, non-competitor). Optional but drives grouping/labelling of competitors.

competitors.description: Column set. The home offering is one of these with home:true.

home.description: True for the Databricks offering (highlighted column).

groups.description: Capability areas, each a block of rows (e.g. Core gateway, Governance, Cost).

cells.description: Map of competitor id → cell. A missing competitor id is treated as "unverified".

status.description: A key from legend (ga/beta/partial/none/unverified or custom).

note.description: Short qualifier shown on hover or inline, e.g. "1,600+ models".

emphasis.description: Render as a standout cell (bold) — a notable strength or gap.

soft.description: Flagged for re-verification before external use.

verdicts.description: Optional per-dimension conclusion, mirroring the deck's verdict lines. Honesty required: winner may be "field".

home.description: What the home offering does on this dimension.

field.description: What the field does on this dimension.
